label: NAV
formula: Latest session-filtered paper_equity.csv equity; live NAV requires broker balance snapshot.

label: Cash
formula: Latest session-filtered paper_equity.csv cash.

label: P&L
formula: Latest realized_pnl + unrealized_pnl; this excludes some fees: do not equate it to total return.

label: Return
formula: 100 × (end NAV / opening NAV − 1), only with verified opening NAV and no external flows.

label: Gross
formula: 100 × sum(abs(position market value in base currency)) / NAV. Futures require contract multiplier; options require declared exposure convention.

label: Net
formula: 100 × signed positions_value / equity for selected paper session; not gross exposure.

label: Leverage
formula: Gross exposure / NAV; needs currency-normalized positions and derivative multipliers.

label: Turnover
formula: Sum absolute target-weight changes per rebalance; repository BookBacktest.avg_turnover is historical average, not live turnover.

label: Drawdown
formula: 100 × drawdown_pct in latest paper equity row. Positive loss magnitude; current drawdown, not historical maximum.

label: Recovery
formula: NAV / running peak NAV × 100; recovery level, not time-to-recovery.

label: Equities
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: ETFs
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Bonds
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Credit
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Rates
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Energy
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Metals
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Agriculture
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Futures
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Digital
formula: 100 × gross notional in selected asset bucket / total gross notional, after FX and multiplier normalization. Categories overlap: ETF/futures are wrappers; do not sum these ten tiles.

label: Quotes
formula: Quote.mid for selected symbol; include venue, currency and exchange timestamp.

label: Candles
formula: Count completed OHLCV bars in selected window.

label: Volume
formula: Quote.volume for selected venue/session; volume units are instrument-specific.

label: Spread
formula: 10000 × (ask − bid) / mid, valid positive uncrossed quote required.

label: Depth
formula: Sum book size over declared number of bid/ask levels; never mix units.

label: Imbalance
formula: 100 × (bid size − ask size)/(bid size + ask size) over declared depth.

label: Trades
formula: Count observed tape prints over declared window; not Quote.volume.

label: Volatility
formula: Annualized sample return standard deviation; specify bar frequency, window and annualization.

label: Freshness
formula: Now − source observation time; reject future timestamps and stale data.

label: Coverage
formula: 100 × valid fresh symbols / expected symbols in selected universe.

label: Macro
formula: Display named macro series from IntelSnapshot.market with timestamp; no generic health percentage.

label: Inflation
formula: Observed inflation series with geography, period and units; not inferred from headlines.

label: Policy
formula: Observed policy-rate series and central bank; categorical decision shown separately.

label: Growth
formula: Observed GDP/growth series with geography, period and revision date.

label: Earnings
formula: Point-in-time earnings value; select EPS or growth explicitly.

label: Valuation
formula: Price-to-book = price / book value per share; exclude default BVPS fallback from measured values.

label: Quality
formula: Selected fundamental metric, e.g. ROE; do not invent a quality composite.

label: Sentiment
formula: IntelSnapshot.fear_greed, preserve null for absent source.

label: Events
formula: IntelSnapshot.global_alert_count for the snapshot; not all historical events.

label: Thesis
formula: Number of generated theses; text shown separately, not a confidence score.

label: Momentum
formula: Actual strategy output strength at last completed bar; retain parameter hash.

label: Reversion
formula: Actual mean-reversion output or specified z-score; do not normalize arbitrarily.

label: Breakout
formula: Actual breakout output on completed bar with configured lookback.

label: EMA
formula: Actual EMA at declared span; price units, not %.

label: RSI
formula: Actual RSI at declared window.

label: MACD
formula: MACD minus signal line at declared periods; price units.

label: Bollinger
formula: Percent-B = (close − lower)/(upper − lower); may exceed 0–100%; mark overflow.

label: Pairs
formula: Pair spread z-score for explicit two-leg pair and hedge model.

label: Regime
formula: RegimeClassifier result category; risk_scalar as separate numeric field.

label: Conviction
formula: Actual selected scorer output + configuration; not demo conviction matrix or fixed offsets.

label: Rank
formula: Rank actual CrossSectionalRanker prediction within an explicit universe; 1 is highest.

label: Breadth
formula: 100 × symbols above selected moving average / valid symbols.

label: Dispersion
formula: Cross-sectional standard deviation of aligned returns over selected interval.

label: Factors
formula: Selected raw ranker feature or fitted exposure with model version; not generic factor strength.

label: Sectors
formula: Classified sector gross weight / total gross × 100; overlap rules documented.

label: Correlation
formula: Mean off-diagonal pairwise correlation over aligned sample; show window, N and missing policy.

label: Clusters
formula: Number of clusters from a declared method; no production clustering output located.

label: Eigenmodes
formula: Selected eigenvalue/eigenvalue sum; no production eigen-spectrum output located.

label: Denoising
formula: Explicit denoising residual or retained-rank statistic; no production implementation located.

label: Rotation
formula: Sector rank change between two comparable snapshots.

label: Heat
formula: 100 × open risk dollars / equity; compare against configured heat cap, not a generic 0–100 green gauge.

label: Trade risk
formula: 100 × intent.risk_dollars / equity; include stop, quantity and contract multiplier.

label: VaR
formula: Historical VaR = −5th percentile of one-period returns. Show confidence, horizon and sample size.

label: ES
formula: ES = negative mean returns at/below 5th percentile. Same sample/horizon as VaR.

label: Beta
formula: Cov(portfolio returns, benchmark)/Var(benchmark); hedge beta is not portfolio beta.

label: Stress
formula: Loss under a named scenario and current holdings; no generic stress percentage.

label: Liquidity
formula: Selected spread/depth/volume constraint; choose one metric and units.

label: Position cap
formula: Current symbol notional / permitted symbol notional × 100; distinguish reject versus resize.

label: Daily budget
formula: Used daily trade count / configured count cap × 100; notional budget is separate.

label: Kill-switch
formula: KillSwitch.state().halted; red HALTED, otherwise READY only if source is reachable.

label: Backtest
formula: Completed backtest trade count; identify symbol, strategy, window and config.

label: Sharpe
formula: sqrt(bars/year) × mean return / population std; repository assumes zero risk-free rate.

label: Sortino
formula: Repository uses std of negative returns, not lower partial moment over all observations; label convention.

label: Calmar
formula: CAGR / absolute maximum drawdown; undefined at zero drawdown.

label: Win rate
formula: 100 × profitable closed trades / all closed trades; no trades is undefined.

label: Payoff
formula: Mean positive P&L / abs(mean negative P&L); undefined without wins and losses.

label: Costs
formula: Observed commissions + identified execution costs; model cost drag remains a backtest estimate.

label: Slippage
formula: Direction-adjusted (fill − arrival/reference price) / reference × 10000. Positive is adverse.

label: Walk-forward
formula: Walk-forward out-of-sample objective score; objective-specific, never a probability.

label: Stability
formula: WFE = OOS score / in-sample score; undefined/unstable near zero denominator.

label: Intent
formula: Count unique published intents within scope; distinguish unresolved from resolved.

label: Sizing
formula: Actual post-gate resized quantity with instrument units.

label: Risk gate
formula: GateDecision accepted flag plus all rejection reasons.

label: Review
formula: Count unresolved, unexpired prompts; not a percentage.

label: Accept
formula: ACCEPT count among retained or scoped decisions; display scope.

label: Decline
formula: DECLINE count among retained or scoped decisions.

label: Routing
formula: Selected broker routing destination; categorical, never a percentage.

label: Fill
formula: Count actual execution fills from paper_fills.jsonl; Router fills.jsonl can mean submission acknowledgment.

label: Reject
formula: Count risk-gate rejects only; exclude broker errors and card decline/expiry.

label: Journal
formula: Timestamp of last valid event in selected journal; not a health guarantee.

label: Card ID
formula: Registered card identity; redact in public exports.

label: Public key
formula: Registered public-key fingerprint; never show private key.

label: Signature
formula: Last verification result and timestamp; exact order signature does not currently bind ACCEPT/DECLINE.

label: Account
formula: Bound account alias; redact sensitive identifiers.

label: Broker
formula: Bound broker name in canonical bytes.

label: Nonce
formula: Nonce presence/uniqueness status; never score entropy from appearance.

label: Intent ID
formula: Unique intent identity and consumption state.

label: TTL
formula: max(0, expires_at − now) seconds for selected intent.

label: Replay check
formula: Observed replay refusal state; not a timeless security score.

label: Passbook
formula: Count retained passbook records; storage capacity and retention must be separate.

label: CPU
formula: Measured device CPU busy percentage over declared sampling interval.

label: Memory
formula: Used / total device RAM × 100.

label: Storage
formula: Used / total selected filesystem bytes × 100.

label: Thermals
formula: Actual named device temperature sensor.

label: Power
formula: Actual power sensor reading, not CPU TDP.

label: Wi-Fi
formula: Wi-Fi RSSI from physical device interface.

label: Latency
formula: Measured API round-trip median over declared sample window.

label: Display
formula: Display connected/error status from local driver.

label: Controls
formula: Input self-test/event freshness for physical controls.

label: Uptime
formula: Device monotonic uptime, not scraper/server uptime.

label: API health
formula: Health endpoint reachability, status and observation time.

label: Queue
formula: Count pending unexpired approval prompts.

label: Database
formula: Database integrity check result with timestamp, not file existence.

label: Backup
formula: Age and success of last verified restore test; existence is not recoverability.

label: Alerts
formula: Count emitted alerts over declared window and delivery result.

label: Logs
formula: Malformed/failed journal events in declared window.

label: Config
formula: Active configuration fingerprint compared with research configuration.

label: Pairing
formula: Registered/revoked pairing state for selected card.

label: Updates
formula: Installed version versus explicitly approved release.

label: Deployment
formula: Actual host/service state with source observation time.
